scope: First outcome inspection on 21 previously untested public source tasks, five families, each original and a declared a16s1 extension; 8 previously observed Rover scale configurations are development diagnostics. Strong finite goal policy, not deadend recognition as success. Do not read source plans, result files or dead.pddl. No filtering based on solver outcomes.
limits: H60 fresh; H16 Rover diagnostics. 256 initial models, 20000 grounded actions; reject rather than truncate. Same indexed exact engine, all initialization/selection included. Optional work <=3s/run, <=.25s/query, <=64 attempts; atomic calls may overrun. Amortized variants reuse selected atom identities with current values/effects and reselect only on loss of common values, <=4 attempts. Resource-tree control work<=300000/run.
queries: Separate diagnostic: automatic root selection only, thresholds1..16, up to8s total/.5s per bound query; first C0-pass/C1-reject query gets a fresh resource-aware Kraft control (4s/300000 work), exact all 2- and 3-world projections (8s per level), and independent full oracle (8s). Incomplete checks are UNKNOWN, never reported as passes.
